passages.text: Now when men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they took as wives whomever they chose.
passages.sermon:
Men began to increase in number on the earth.
Daughters were born to these men.
The sons of God saw the daughters of men.
The sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful.
The sons of God took wives from among the daughters of men.
The sons of God chose any women they wanted as their wives.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־ הֵחֵ֣ל הָֽאָדָ֔ם לָרֹ֖ב עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֖וֹת יֻלְּד֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃ וַיִּרְא֤וּ בְנֵי־ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֥י טֹבֹ֖ת הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּקְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: So the LORD said, “My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke.
The LORD said, "My Spirit will not contend with man forever."
Man is mortal.
Man is flesh.
Man's days will be one hundred and twenty years."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה לֹֽא־ יָד֨וֹן רוּחִ֤י בָֽאָדָם֙ לְעֹלָ֔ם בְּשַׁגַּ֖ם ה֣וּא בָשָׂ֑ר וְהָי֣וּ יָמָ֔יו מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and afterward as well—when the sons of God had relations with the daughters of men. And they bore them children who became the mighty men of old, men of renown.
passages.sermon:
The Nephilim lived on the earth in those days.
They also lived on the earth after that time.
The sons of God went to the daughters of men.
The sons of God had children with the daughters of men.
Their children became mighty men.
These mighty men lived long ago.
People knew these men for their great deeds.
passages.original: הַנְּפִלִ֞ים הָי֣וּ בָאָרֶץ֮ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֒ וְגַ֣ם אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֜אוּ בְּנֵ֤י הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְיָלְד֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם הֵ֧מָּה הַגִּבֹּרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵעוֹלָ֖ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַשֵּֽׁם׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
God looked at the people on the earth.
God saw that people were very wicked.
God saw that people did many evil things.
God saw that every thought in each person’s heart was evil.
God saw that people thought about evil all the time.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י רַבָּ֛ה רָעַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכָל־ יֵ֙צֶר֙ מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ת לִבּ֔וֹ רַ֥ק רַ֖ע כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: And the LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
God made man on the earth.
God saw what man had become.
God regretted that He had made man.
God felt deep sorrow in His heart.
passages.original: וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתְעַצֵּ֖ב אֶל־ לִבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So the LORD said, “I will blot out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth—every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air—for I am grieved that I have made them.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD created man.
The LORD saw that man was wicked on the earth.
The LORD spoke.
The LORD said, “I will blot out man from the face of the earth.
I created man.
I will remove every man.
I will remove every beast.
I will remove every crawling creature.
I will remove every bird of the air.
I am grieved that I made them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה אֶמְחֶ֨ה אֶת־ הָאָדָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּרָ֙אתִי֙ מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה מֵֽאָדָם֙ עַד־ בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַד־ רֶ֖מֶשׂ וְעַד־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י נִחַ֖מְתִּי כִּ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽם׃

passages.text: Noah, however, found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a man.
Noah lived at a time when the earth was corrupt and full of violence.
God saw the evil on the earth.
God was grieved that He had made man.
God decided to destroy all living things from the earth.
But Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
passages.original: וְנֹ֕חַ מָ֥צָא חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: This is the account of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a man.
Noah lived during a corrupt and violent time.
Noah was righteous.
Noah was blameless among the people of his generation.
Noah walked with God.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת נֹ֔חַ נֹ֗חַ אִ֥ישׁ צַדִּ֛יק תָּמִ֥ים הָיָ֖ה בְּדֹֽרֹתָ֑יו אֶת־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־ נֹֽחַ׃

passages.text: And Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a righteous man.
Noah was blameless in his generation.
Noah walked with God.
Noah had three sons.
Their names were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
passages.original: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד נֹ֖חַ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים אֶת־ שֵׁ֖ם אֶת־ חָ֥ם וְאֶת־ יָֽפֶת׃

passages.text: Now the earth was corrupt in the sight of God, and full of violence.
passages.sermon: God saw the earth.\r\nThe earth was corrupt.\r\nThe earth was full of violence.
passages.original: וַתִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ חָמָֽס׃

passages.text: And God looked upon the earth and saw that it was corrupt; for all living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways.
passages.sermon: God looked at the earth.\r\nGod saw the earth was corrupt.\r\nAll living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֣ה נִשְׁחָ֑תָה כִּֽי־ הִשְׁחִ֧ית כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֛ר אֶת־ דַּרְכּ֖וֹ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

passages.text: Then God said to Noah, “The end of all living creatures has come before Me, because through them the earth is full of violence. Now behold, I will destroy both them and the earth.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God said, “All living creatures will come to an end.
I see them before Me.
They have filled the earth with violence.
Because of them, the earth is full of violence.
Now I will destroy them.
I will also destroy the earth.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְנֹ֗חַ קֵ֤ץ כָּל־ בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֣א לְפָנַ֔י כִּֽי־ מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ חָמָ֖ס מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְהִנְנִ֥י מַשְׁחִיתָ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God gave Noah instructions.
God told Noah to build an ark.
Noah must use gopher wood to build the ark.
Noah must make rooms inside the ark.
Noah must cover the ark with pitch.
Noah must cover the ark with pitch on the inside.
Noah must cover the ark with pitch on the outside.
passages.original: עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ תֵּבַ֣ת עֲצֵי־ גֹ֔פֶר קִנִּ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֶת־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה וְכָֽפַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛הּ מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ בַּכֹּֽפֶר׃

passages.text: And this is how you are to build it: The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God gave Noah instructions for building the ark.
God said, "This is how you must build the ark."
The ark must be 300 cubits long.
The ark must be 50 cubits wide.
The ark must be 30 cubits high.
passages.original: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֹתָ֑הּ שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַתֵּבָ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: You are to make a roof for the ark, finish its walls a cubit from the top, place a door in the side of the ark, and build lower, middle, and upper decks.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God gave Noah instructions for building the ark.
Noah must make a roof for the ark.
Noah must leave an opening one cubit below the roof.
Noah must put a door in the side of the ark.
Noah must build three decks inside the ark.
The decks must be lower, middle, and upper.
passages.original: צֹ֣הַר׀ תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה לַתֵּבָ֗ה וְאֶל־ אַמָּה֙ תְּכַלֶ֣נָּה מִלְמַ֔עְלָה וּפֶ֥תַח הַתֵּבָ֖ה בְּצִדָּ֣הּ תָּשִׂ֑ים תַּחְתִּיִּ֛ם שְׁנִיִּ֥ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶֽׂהָ׃

passages.text: And behold, I will bring floodwaters upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has the breath of life. Everything on the earth will perish.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God said He would send a flood.
God would bring water over the whole earth.
God would destroy every living thing under the sky.
Every creature with the breath of life would die.
Everything on the earth would perish.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶת־ הַמַּבּ֥וּל מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁר־ בּוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ חַיִּ֔ים מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ בָּאָ֖רֶץ יִגְוָֽע׃

passages.text: But I will establish My covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God promised to make a covenant with Noah.
God said He would keep His promise to Noah.
God told Noah to enter the ark.
Noah would go into the ark.
Noah’s sons would go with him.
Noah’s wife would go with him.
The wives of Noah’s sons would go with them.
God included Noah and his family in His promise.
passages.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וּבָאתָ֙ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֔ה אַתָּ֕ה וּבָנֶ֛יךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ֥ וּנְשֵֽׁי־ בָנֶ֖יךָ אִתָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: And you are to bring two of every living creature into the ark—male and female—to keep them alive with you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God told Noah to bring animals into the ark.
Noah must bring two of every living creature.
Noah must bring one male and one female of each kind.
Noah must keep these animals alive with him in the ark.
passages.original: וּמִכָּל־ הָ֠חַי מִֽכָּל־ בָּשָׂ֞ר שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל תָּבִ֥יא אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֖ה לְהַחֲיֹ֣ת אִתָּ֑ךְ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: Two of every kind of bird and animal and crawling creature will come to you to be kept alive.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God told Noah to prepare for a flood.
God said that He would save Noah and his family.
God commanded Noah to bring animals into the ark.
Two of every kind of bird will come to Noah.
Two of every kind of animal will come to Noah.
Two of every kind of crawling creature will come to Noah.
Each pair will come to Noah by their own kind.
Noah must keep these animals alive.
passages.original: מֵהָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֗הוּ וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ מִכֹּ֛ל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְהַֽחֲיֽוֹת׃

passages.text: You are also to take for yourself every kind of food that is eaten and gather it as food for yourselves and for the animals.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God told Noah to take every kind of food that people can eat.
God told Noah to gather this food for himself.
God told Noah to gather this food for the animals.
This food would be for Noah to eat.
This food would be for the animals to eat.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־ לְךָ֗ מִכָּל־ מַֽאֲכָל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֛ וְלָהֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃

passages.text: So Noah did everything precisely as God had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a righteous man.
God gave Noah commands.
Noah did everything God commanded him.
Noah obeyed God completely.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס
